quests.name: Sea of Abyss: Clearing
quests.description: Clear Sea of Abyss of the creatures that crowd its paths.

quests.name: Sea of Abyss: Bounty
quests.description: A standing bounty on Faugn, paid every hour to whoever brings proof.

quests.name: Sea of Abyss: Night Watch
quests.description: At night Sathla grow bold. Hunt them while the moon is high.

quests.name: Sea of Abyss: Purge
quests.description: A week-long purge of the strongest creatures of Sea of Abyss.

quests.name: Sea of Abyss: Master Hunter
quests.description: Prove yourself a master hunter of Sea of Abyss: bring down a hundred Sathla.
